coverage: Actual SIGKILL before/after release intent, retirement, per-target release and final completion commit.
Recovery preserves prior receipts, committed verification digest and progress, and rolls back uncommitted transactions.
Recovered journal passes SQLite integrity_check and accepts a new transaction.
Native coordinator rejects released/pending, pending/retired and retired/released orderings before RPC.
Native lost retirement/release acknowledgement recovery remains successful after restoring valid progress.
limits: Child-process tests execute journal transactions, not the complete coordinator and remote RPC stack.
Native tests cover lost acknowledgements and eviction separately from journal process death.
Power loss, production deployment, installation-wide isolation and complete operator recovery remain unqualified.
